messages:
marta (sec-lead): FYI we've scheduled a short pen-test with RedTeamCo for 2026-04-02 09:00 PDT. Primary requirements: ephemeral assume-role, scoped KMS decrypt for evidence, and verifiable object-level audit trails. Planning a 30m dry-run on 2026-04-01 10:00. @tess @pranav please confirm RBAC/KMS approach. cc @jon for audit retention.

Tess (eng-sre): quick clarifying q: vendor wants to assume a role in our account or cross-account access? If in-account, we can lock session durations and deny writes. :thinking_face:

marta (sec-lead): vendor prefers assume-role in our account. They provided a list of vendor principals. They only need readonly S3 + logs and kms:Decrypt on a single key.

pranav (infra): ephemeral role approach sounds good. Plan: create role redteam/assessor-role with trust policy limited to vendor principals, session max 1h, permissions: s3:GetObject/ListBucket (only evidence bucket), logs:FilterLogEvents/GetLogEvents (audit groups), and kms:Decrypt for key ARN. Key policy must allow Grant to the role. We'll also attach a permission boundary that prevents PutObject/DeleteObject.

jon (platform): telemetry notes: enable CloudTrail data events for S3 object reads on the evidence bucket and forward to a locked archive bucket with MFA-delete. Set CloudWatch LogGroup retention to 365d for this engagement and enable object-level access logging. We must be able to prove reads during retest.

Tess (eng-sre): sample role policy (please review):

```json
{
  \"Version\": \"2012-10-17\",
  \"Statement\": [
    {
      \"Effect\": \"Allow\",
      \"Action\": [\"s3:GetObject\", \"s3:ListBucket\"],
      \"Resource\": [\"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence\", \"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*\"]
    },
    {
      \"Effect\": \"Allow\",
      \"Action\": [\"logs:GetLogEvents\", \"logs:FilterLogEvents\"],
      \"Resource\": [\"arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:123456789012:log-group:/redwood/pt/*\"]
    },
    {
      \"Effect\": \"Allow\",
      \"Action\": [\"kms:Decrypt\"],
      \"Resource\": [\"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789\"]
    }
  ]
}
```

marta (sec-lead): legal note: we cannot hand over key material or plaintext. Use KMS Grants scoped to the role and require encryptionContext constraint. Decrypt audit logs must be retained 90+ days. @pranav can you handle grant creation and lifecycle?

pranav (infra): yes. I'll create a KMS Grant scoped to the assessor role and constrain by EncryptionContext: {\"evidence-origin\":\"redteamco\"}. I'll record grant ID and revoke it immediately after the engagement. I'll post CloudFormation snippet in staging. ETA: staging prep by 2026-03-30 EOD.

jon (platform): one more: some runtime artifacts write to the same bucket under prefix /models/. Block assessor access to arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/models/* explicitly. Also enable S3 server access logs so we get object-level reads.

Tess (eng-sre): acknowledged. I'll add an explicit Deny for the models prefix in the role policy and include that in the runbook. I'll also run a pre-dry-run checklist and share results 2026-03-31.

marta (sec-lead): action items: 1) pranav: create role + KMS grant in staging (due 2026-03-30) 2) tess: pre-dry-run checklist & runbook (due 2026-03-31) 3) jon: enable CloudTrail data events + S3 access logs (due 2026-03-31) 4) marta: upload vendor ARNs to assessor whitelist (today).

jon (platform): calendar invite sent for dry-run 2026-04-01 10:00 PDT. audit-bot will attach notes. :calendar:

audit-bot: automated note - CloudTrail data events enabled for arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence. Retention lifecycle configured to 395 days in locked archive.

Tess (eng-sre): small compatibility check: our services write generated artifacts to /generated/; we'll add resource exclusions for /models/* and /generated/* so assessors can't read those.

marta (sec-lead): good catch. Add to checklist. Also planning: schedule retest 1h slot in the week of 2026-04-15 once remediation complete. I'll file retest request after report intake.

pranav (infra): posting CloudFormation snippet for role + grant later today. Will include grant rotation/revocation steps.

Tess (eng-sre): posting pre-dry-run checklist in ~1h.

marta (sec-lead): thanks all. keeping thread open for artifacts and final signoffs. :wave:
